question: Show me detailed visual analytics and statistics of inspection scores across all establishments.
output_text:
## Inspection-score overview

The inspection dataset contains **7,798 scored inspections** across **1,291 establishments**.

| Statistic | Inspection score |
|---|---:|
| Mean | **10.29** |
| Median | **7** |
| Standard deviation | **12.07** |
| Minimum | **0** |
| Maximum | **297** |
| Zero-score inspections | **710** (**9.1%**) |

The mean being higher than the median indicates a **right-skewed distribution**: most inspections have relatively low scores, while a smaller number of high-score inspections pull the average upward.

## Score distribution

- **0:** 710 inspections (**9.1%**)
- **1–9:** 4,006 (**51.4%**)
- **10–19:** 1,994 (**25.6%**)
- **20–29:** 672 (**8.6%**)
- **30–39:** 261 (**3.3%**)
- **40+:** 155 (**2.0%**)

Together, **86.1%** of scored inspections were below 20, while **5.3%** were 30 or higher. The distribution chart shows that scores in the **1–9** range are by far the most common outcome.

## Trend over time

Annual average scores varied over the available 2009–2026 history:

- The highest annual average in the data was **13.00 in 2015** (77 inspections).
- More recent averages declined from **12.08 in 2022** and **12.01 in 2023** to **11.49 in 2024**, **8.90 in 2025**, and **6.33 in 2026**.
- The 2026 figure is based on **865 inspections** and should be interpreted as the data currently available for that year, rather than necessarily a complete annual total.

Median scores tell a similar story: they were **9 in 2022**, **8 in 2023–2024**, **6 in 2025**, and **5 in 2026**.

## By inspection type

| Inspection type | Inspections | Average score | Median score |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Routine | 7,380 | **10.45** | 8 |
| Followup | 211 | **6.19** | 3 |
| Critical Item | 202 | **9.02** | 3 |
| Complaint Investigation | 5 | **1.80** | 0 |

Routine inspections account for **94.6%** of all scored inspections, so they largely determine the countywide distribution and trend.

## Coverage note

These inspection statistics come from the SLCHD inspection records, not from every Google-listed restaurant in the broader establishment dataset. Only **139 of 8,592 Google establishments (1.62%)** are matched to an SLCHD listing; therefore, a missing matched inspection record should **not** be interpreted as a clean inspection history.

messages.name: get_schema

args.query: WITH scored AS (SELECT inspection_score FROM inspections WHERE inspection_score IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) AS scored_inspections, COUNT(DISTINCT slchd_establishment_key) AS establishments_with_scored_inspections, MIN(inspection_score) AS min_score, MAX(inspection_score) AS max_score, ROUND(AVG(inspection_score),2) AS mean_score, ROUND(MEDIAN(inspection_score),2) AS median_score, ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(inspection_score),2) AS sd_score, SUM(CASE WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_score_inspections FROM inspections WHERE inspection_score IS NOT NULL;

SELECT CASE WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN '0' WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN '1–9' WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN '10–19' WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20–29' WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30–39' WHEN inspection_score >= 40 THEN '40+' END AS score_band, COUNT(*) AS inspections FROM inspections WHERE inspection_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE score_band WHEN '0' THEN 0 WHEN '1–9' THEN 1 WHEN '10–19' THEN 2 WHEN '20–29' THEN 3 WHEN '30–39' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM inspection_date)::INTEGER AS year, COUNT(*) AS inspections, ROUND(AVG(inspection_score),2) AS mean_score, ROUND(MEDIAN(inspection_score),2) AS median_score FROM inspections WHERE inspection_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT it.description AS inspection_type, COUNT(*) AS inspections, ROUND(AVG(i.inspection_score),2) AS mean_score, ROUND(MEDIAN(i.inspection_score),2) AS median_score FROM inspections i LEFT JOIN inspection_types it ON i.inspection_type_id = it.inspection_type_id WHERE i.inspection_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY inspections DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_google_establishments, COUNT(slchd_establishment_key) AS matched_google_establishments, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(slchd_establishment_key) / COUNT(*),2) AS matched_pct FROM establishments;

SELECT CASE WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN '0' WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN '1–9' WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN '10–19' WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20–29' WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30–39' WHEN inspection_score >= 40 THEN '40+' END AS score_band, COUNT(*) AS inspections FROM inspections WHERE inspection_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE score_band WHEN '0' THEN 0 WHEN '1–9' THEN 1 WHEN '10–19' THEN 2 WHEN '20–29' THEN 3 WHEN '30–39' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END;
